what_this_is_not: Both sides were recorded once, live, by test/fixtures/gen_bridge_readback_p1.R; this tool copies them and runs neither R nor Julia. The readback cases compare the R bridge methods with GLLVModels on the same inputs in the same process: they show that the R adapter returns what Julia computes, not that Julia agrees with engine = "tmb" (only the gllvm_julia_fit cases compare with the native R engine). One Gaussian, no-X, complete-response fixture; predict is in-sample (newdata is gated on the bridge).
